verdict.rationale: Ironclad markets an 'Ironclad AI'/'Contract Intelligence' product page, implying AI-driven insights on contract data, but the evidence pack contains only page titles/taglines with no concrete description of what insights or suggestions are actually generated or how they surface in-product. Missing for 10: detailed docs on AI insight/suggestion features, example outputs, and independent/hands-on corroboration of AI-generated insights actually working.
